about_the_game:
In a dark future, a powerful pharmaceutical company rules the country. This company sells pills that temporarily suppress the effects of diseases — not cure them. Desperate and out of options, you start working for them. Your job: to analyze patient reports and select the pill that best fits the company’s goals.

Each report contains key data such as the patient’s age, gender, whether they are an implanted human, and any allergies. You must eliminate all incompatible options, then choose the most expensive pill that still fits.

Every patient receives exactly one capsule. Place it in the delivery box, press the button, and a drone will carry it away. But beware: giving the wrong pill reduces the company’s trust in you, increasing your chance of being killed. Survive as long as you can under growing pressure and scrutiny.

Features

• A strategy-based simulation where you choose pills based on detailed case reports

• Single-capsule-per-patient system with drone delivery mechanics

• Company trust meter — wrong choices raise your chance of death

• Time management under mounting pressure

• A mysterious voice guiding (or manipulating?) your actions

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card

short_description: In a dark future, a pharmaceutical company rules the country. We have no choice but to work for this company, but it is almost impossible to please the boss! Use strategy and intelligence to try to adapt to this complex system.
